# Acquisition and operations

## Agency prospecting

Use Sales for research, qualification, discovery and proposals. Target measurable demand, capacity and viable scope alongside conversion opportunity. Prepare sourced prospects and tailored outreach without inventing relationships/results. Sending requires applicable authorization and recipient verification. Maintain pipeline from actual interactions and preserve commitments. Use Sales Pitch Reviewer for the opportunity story; model prices from explicit cost/time assumptions. Build case studies from consented measured results; prepare referral requests within scope.

## Client demand

Prioritize buyer-intent program/car/track pages, comparisons/logistics, accurate local business information, approved footage and proof. Verify current SEO/AI guidance before technical prescriptions. Keep facts crawlable and structured data consistent with visible text. Repeat AI probes with recorded prompt, engine/date, citations and errors; disclose sampling limits and track attributable inquiries where possible. Do not promise ranking or AI recommendations. Paid campaigns need approved scope/budget.

## Revenue operations

Map inquiry receipt to owner, response, qualification, quote, booking and completion. Use approved channels/cadences. Handle duplicates, delivery failures, opt-outs, reassignment and stale records. Use stable IDs and deterministic reminder/webhook jobs. Test with isolated records before client messages. Distinguish proposed, authorized, executed and externally confirmed actions.

## Client success

Track support intake, impact, affected release, evidence and resolution. Prioritize failed bookings, lost leads, payment discrepancies and access failures. Stop harmful workflows and reconcile transactions within approved recovery scope. Escalate with a remedy; do not promise 24/7 staffed support.

Prepare concise outcome reports with baselines, limitations and next actions. Monitor maintenance/access/integrations through explicitly authorized schedules. Prepare invoices only when terms support them; sending/charging requires applicable authorization. Propose expansion from observed bottlenecks. Support owned-asset handoff, data export and agency-access revocation during agreed offboarding.
